steps.title: Check your own talk. Which of them did you do?
steps.model: Opening: My name is… and I’m here to talk to you about…

steps.title: Отметь, чему научился
items: ✓ use everyday narrative words — bring up, stay up, burning, neighbour, risky
✓ open a talk by naming the subject — I’m here to talk to you about…
✓ announce a plan and keep to it — First… Then… And finally…
✓ signpost a new section — Now, let’s move on to…
✓ close properly — To sum up… Thank you for listening. Are there any questions?
✓ take notes in four words a line, keeping every number
